result.stdout:
monorepo-dotnet — interactive ASP.NET Core solution generator

Usage: monorepo [--help]

The CLI is interactive: it asks for the solution name, output directory,
target framework, architecture (DDD, Clean, 1-Layer, MVC), database, Docker and 
optional packages.

Requirements: .NET SDK 10.0.100+, Docker (optional), dotnet-ef (optional).
